sections.title: Overview
sections.body: The Launchpad is your home screen in CRETA. It provides a quick overview of what needs your attention and gives you access to all modules. The content you see is tailored to your role — controllers see pending approvals, cost center owners see resource requests, and project leads see forecast deadlines.

sections.title: Notifications & Alerts
sections.body: The top section displays role-aware alerts. **Controllers** see pending change requests awaiting approval and new project submissions in the intake queue. **Cost Center Owners** see incoming resource requests and CR-linked confirmations (the final stage of the CR workflow). **Project Leads** see forecast review deadlines, CR approval notifications, and sent-back CRs requiring action (with controller feedback). **Executives** see portfolio health summaries and published scenarios. Click any notification to navigate directly to the relevant screen.

sections.title: Pending Actions
sections.body: Below the notifications, the Pending Actions panel lists specific workflow items that require your attention. Each action shows a summary, the related module, and a timestamp. **Urgent items** are highlighted with a red bar on the left edge so you can prioritize them at a glance. Clicking any action deep-links directly to the relevant module, tab, and entity — for example, clicking a pending CR approval navigates to Portfolio Overview > CR Approvals with that specific CR selected. When all actions are resolved, the panel shows an 'All caught up' message.

sections.title: Module Tiles
sections.body: The middle section shows module cards ordered by relevance to your role. Each tile displays the module name, a brief description, and a contextual metric (e.g., 'Your 4 projects, 1 forecast overdue'). Click a tile to open that module full-screen. Modules you don't have access to are hidden. The **Reporting** tile provides access to five standard reports, the **Report Builder** (OLAP-style custom report composition), and the **AI Report Builder** (natural language report generation).

sections.title: Submit New Project
sections.body: Project Leads see a prominent 'Submit New Project' button. This is the only entry point for creating new project proposals. Clicking it opens a structured form where you define the project scope, timeline, resource needs, and external costs. The system auto-calculates estimated costs from blended hourly rates. Once submitted, the proposal appears in the Controller's Intake Queue.

sections.title: Role Switcher
sections.body: The role switcher dropdown in the top-right corner lets you switch between demo personas. Each persona has different module access, data visibility, and write permissions. Switching roles immediately updates all views to reflect that role's perspective.

sections.title: Dark Mode Toggle
sections.body: Next to the role switcher in the top-right corner, the **Sun/Moon** icon button lets you switch between display themes. Click it to cycle through three modes: **Light** (default, sun icon), **Dark** (moon icon), and **System** (follows your operating system's preference). The selected theme applies immediately across all modules, charts, dialogs, and data visualizations. Your preference is saved to the browser and persists across sessions.
